title: Telepon Petugas Dukungan
attacker_character: vishing: penelpon yang mengaku petugas, suara tenang dan profesional
attacker_goal: meminta korban membacakan kode OTP yang dikirim ke HP mereka sendiri
opener: *telepon masuk* 'Halo, saya petugas dukungan kompetisi. Akun kamu terdeteksi error pembayaran — saya kirimkan kode ke HP kamu sekarang, tolong bacakan kodenya ya supaya bisa saya perbaiki.'
escalation_ladder: klaim error pembayaran + kiriman kode OTP sungguhan
desakan: 'kalau tidak sekarang, pendaftaran kamu batal'
ancaman denda/kerugian lebih besar jika menolak
red_flags: OTP dikirim ke HP KAMU tapi diminta orang lain bacakan
klaim error yang tidak bisa kamu cek sendiri
safe_response: tutup telepon; jangan bacakan kode apa pun; hubungi panitia lewat kanal resmi; blokir nomor
lesson: OTP yang masuk ke HP-mu hanya untukmu. Penelpon 'petugas' yang minta kode sedang mencoba masuk ke akunmu. Menutup telepon adalah pilihan teraman — panitia resmi bisa dihubungi lewat kanal resmi.

en.title: Support Officer Call
en.attacker_character: vishing: caller claiming to be an officer, calm professional voice
en.opener: *incoming call* 'Hello, this is competition support. Your account has a payment error — I'm sending a code to your phone now, please read it back so I can fix it.'
escalation_ladder: payment-error claim + a REAL OTP sent to your phone
asks victim to read the code 'for verification'
pressure: 'if not now, your registration is cancelled'
threats of fines/bigger losses if you refuse
red_flags: unknown number claiming to be an officer
OTP sent to YOUR phone but someone else wants it read
an error claim you cannot verify yourself
en.safe_response: hang up; never read out any code; contact the committee via official channels; block the number
en.lesson: An OTP sent to your phone is for YOU alone. An 'officer' asking for the code is breaking into your account. Hanging up is the safest move — real committees are reachable through official channels.
